section_summary.extract_value: This Methods section describes a single study recruiting 105 participants (45 female, 60 male) via Amazon's MTurk. Participants ranged from 18 to 69 years (M=34.28) and were 80.8% White; they completed six imagined scenarios and the SBAS-2 after each scenario.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: "Participants were recruited from Amazon's MTurk following the general procedure described in Study 1." "The final sample included 105 participants (45 female and 60 male) ranging in age from 18 to 69 (M=34.28, SD=10.72)." "Racial breakdown was as follows: 80.8% White, 9.6% Asian American, 6.7% African American, 1.9% Latina/Latino, and 1.0% multiracial." "These scenarios were presented in random order, and participants completed the SBAS-2 after reading and imagining each situation."
